dispositions.region: Retained moderate best-practice finding on portaled Breadcrumbs menu outside the document landmark; no waiver added and no formal conformance claim.
dispositions.color-contrast: Avatar gradients are inconclusive to axe and have explicit computed-gradient browser checks; CodeBlock single-character gutters are decorative aria-hidden content. This does not declare global contrast passed.
dispositions.aria-valid-attr-value: Popup ID association requires direct DOM reference review; supplementary check pending after isolated workload.
dispositions.label-content-name-mismatch: Visible ellipsis glyph is paired with a descriptive localized Show hidden breadcrumbs label; axe cannot determine text-name inclusion for the symbol.
dispositions.aria-hidden-focus: Modal background is intentionally hidden/inert while open; all-six native keyboard suite checks safe focus and Tab/Shift+Tab containment. No screen-reader result is implied.
